title: Adaptive activation-aware INT8 pipeline, kernel instrumentation, and CI validation gate
creator: Priya Shah
description: Goal: build an end-to-end flow (calibration -> profile generation -> runtime kernel hooks -> CI gating) for activation-aware INT8 quantization that preserves model quality while enabling a safe rollout path. This ticket covers an adaptive per-layer activation scaling profiler, a lightweight calibration controller that emits per-tensor scale maps (adaptive profiles), runtime kernel instrumentation/feature flags to consume profiles and apply fused-op rescaling (attention, layernorm), and a CI gating harness which runs automated accuracy/regression checks against golden datasets and telemetry thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration service can produce per-layer adaptive activation profiles for BERT/GPT family models (JSON profile format and schema validated)
Runtime can ingest a profile at model load time and apply activation rescale via existing fused-kernel paths without a significant increase in P90 latency (<5%)
CI harness rejects any quantized build that shows >0.8% absolute degradation on standard QA prompts or violates token-level perplexity thresholds (configurable per model)
Rollout plan (canary -> gradual -> full) implemented in console with automatic rollback on quality regressions and telemetry anomalies
Comprehensive unit + integration tests added and run in pre-submit and nightly pipelines
proposed_rollout: 1) Produce adaptive profiles in calibration cluster (staging) and run golden comparison locally. 2) Enable runtime feature flag 'adaptive-activation-v1' on a single canary node serving internal traffic. 3) Monitor quality metrics (perplexity, F1 for eval sets, sampling output diffs) and latency/throughput. 4) If stable for 24h, expand to 10% traffic. 5) If stable for additional 48h, expand to 50% then 100%. Automatic rollback when regression > configured threshold or increased error rates.
test_plan: Unit tests for profile serializer/deserializer validating schema changes
Microbench: compare P90 and P99 for fused attention kernels with and without rescale path across sequence lengths [8,32,512]
Regression harness: golden-dataset assembly (1000 prompts across summarization, chat, code), run quantized vs float baseline and compute absolute and relative metric deltas
Stochastic sampling tests for hallucination rate on 5 curated prompts (nightly)
End-to-end smoke: load model with profile, run 1M tokens in staging and assert no kernel panics / OOMs
risks: Per-layer rescaling could expose numerical instability in microkernels for low-precision paths (edge-case activations)
Increased tail latency when rescale path isn't fused into hot kernels; requires kernel changes on multiple backends
Calibration profiles may be dataset-sensitive; poor calibration datasets could cause regressions on customer workloads
Complexity of CI gating might slow developer iteration if thresholds are too strict
